items.title: Fifth ITLOS Workshop for Legal Advisers (sponsored by the Republic of Korea)
items.summary: The fifth ITLOS Workshop for Legal Advisers (sponsored by the Republic of Korea) was opened on 18 September 2026 by the President of the Tribunal, Judge Tomas Heidar, who welcomed 20 participants from the Asian region.

items.title: ITLOS Fisheries Workshop opens in Malta
items.summary: Judge Tomas Heidar opened the Tribunal’s Workshop focusing on the “Sustainable Use of Living Marine Resources and the Role of the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea in the Settlement of Fisheries Disputes” today at IMLI in Malta.

items.title: Case 34 (Nauru Ocean Resources Inc. v. International Seabed Authority) and Case 35 (Tonga Offshore Mining Ltd. v. International Seabed Authority)
items.summary: By Orders of 4 August 2026, Judge Attard, President of the Seabed Disputes Chamber of the Tribunal, has extended the time-limit for the submission of the Defence of the International Seabed Authority to 30 March 2027.

items.title: New arbitrator appointed in the arbitral proceedings instituted by Ukraine against the Russian Federation
items.summary: On 24 July 2026, President Tomas Heidar appointed Mr Alberto Székely y Sánchez (Mexico) as arbitrator in the arbitral proceedings instituted by Ukraine against the Russian Federation under Annex VII to UNCLOS.

items.title: The Tribunal announces with great sadness the passing of Judge Alonso Gómez-Robledo Verduzco
items.summary: It is with great sadness that the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea announces the passing of Judge Alonso Gómez-Robledo Verduzco (Mexico) on 16 July 2026.
